selected_mechanism.name: Batch Zero Verification RFI process
selected_mechanism.definition: The Batch Zero Verification RFI process is ERCOT's staged evidence review for conditionally classified Large Loads before it provides final Batch Zero eligibility.
selected_mechanism.texas_scope: Large Loads seeking to interconnect in the ERCOT region of Texas through the transitional Batch Zero process.

news_trigger.verbatim_span: In accordance with this directive, ERCOT has begun issuing Batch Zero Verification Requests for Information (RFIs) to a majority of Interconnecting Large Load Entities (ILLEs) with a Large Load that has been conditionally included in Batch Zero.
news_trigger.post_anchor: ERCOT began issuing Batch Zero Verification Requests for Information on September 9, 2026

source.title: M-A090926-01 Issuance of Batch Zero Verification Requests for Information

layers.name: Pause authority layer
layers.function: Suspends the ordinary Batch Zero timetable so verification and audit can finish before the interconnection study continues.
layers.actor_authority: The commission's August 20 order grants ERCOT good cause exceptions from Batch Zero deadlines and permits the verification and audit to precede continuation of the study.

primary_source.title: Project No. 59142 Order Granting Good Cause Exceptions

layers.name: Conditional classification layer
layers.function: Assigns each submitted Large Load a provisional status and identifies conditions it must satisfy before final inclusion.
layers.actor_authority: ERCOT administers the Batch Zero classification process under Planning Guide Section 9 and issued provisional classifications to transmission and distribution service providers.

primary_source.title: M-A080326-04 Batch Zero Conditional Classification issued to Transmission and/or Distribution Service Providers

layers.name: Evidence and attestation layer
layers.function: Routes party-specific questions, supporting documents, exhibit lists, and notarized attestations through ERCOT's RIOO portal.
layers.actor_authority: ERCOT directs the interconnecting transmission provider to designate contacts and coordinate complete responses from the load entity and any distribution provider.

primary_source.title: Large Load Integration, Batch Zero Verification

layers.name: Eligibility determination layer
layers.function: Reviews the complete response, may request clarification, and determines whether the Large Load remains eligible for Batch Zero.
layers.actor_authority: ERCOT notifies the interconnecting transmission provider when it determines eligibility and excludes a load that does not timely provide a complete response or otherwise satisfy verification.

primary_source.title: M-A090926-01 Issuance of Batch Zero Verification Requests for Information

chokepoint.binary_decision: Determine that a conditionally classified Large Load is eligible for inclusion in Batch Zero, or exclude it from the Batch Zero interconnection process.
chokepoint.post_decision_phrase: determine eligibility for inclusion in Batch Zero
chokepoint.why_asymmetric: The transmission provider, load entity, and any distribution provider assemble the record, but only ERCOT makes the eligibility determination that keeps the load in or excludes it from Batch Zero.

selected_mechanism.texas_consequence: A conditionally classified Large Load in the ERCOT region that fails the verification gate is excluded from Batch Zero and cannot rely on that transitional study path to advance its interconnection.
selected_mechanism.structural_read: The process separates distributed evidence assembly from centralized gatekeeping. Several project-side actors must produce the record, while ERCOT alone controls the eligibility outcome. That makes response completeness and timing part of interconnection readiness rather than administrative cleanup after the study begins.
selected_mechanism.forward_implication: The next useful accountability signal is whether ERCOT's September 15 Batch Zero update describes RFI issuance, completed responses, or eligibility outcomes, followed by the separate Market Notice promised for the community-impact RFI.
